releaseNotes: 6D6X6 2.5.71.0: adds a Windows 11-specific low-latency media pipeline. DXGI capture no longer waits for BGRA-to-NV12 conversion and H.264 encoding; stale raw frames are replaced by the newest frame. The converter reads same-size BGRA frames once, Media Foundation input buffers are reused, and five-second capture/encode timing diagnostics were added. Windows 10 keeps the existing media path.
